might.name: Might
might.description: Strength, leverage and physical force. Combines with Athletics for lifting, hauling and forceful expedition routes.

dexterity.name: Dexterity
dexterity.description: Agility and precision. Combines with Fieldcraft for crossings and Artifice for mechanisms. At 8: +1 crafting work.

vitality.name: Vitality
vitality.description: Physical endurance and resilience. Combines with Athletics for sustained effort and safe endurance routes; at 8: receiving first aid or resting restores one extra health (maximum 6).

intelligence.name: Intelligence
intelligence.description: Reasoning, knowledge and understanding. Combines with Scholarship for ciphers and Artifice for engineering. At 8: +1 research/archive work.

resolve.name: Resolve
resolve.description: Willpower, concentration and composure. Combines with Channeling for magical control. At 8: +1 personal spell preparation slot.

charisma.name: Charisma
charisma.description: Persuasion, expression and social presence. Combines with Diplomacy for additional conversational and negotiation approaches. Never replaces ordinary responses.

athletics.name: Athletics
athletics.description: Training in lifting, climbing and endurance. Each rank adds 2 to relevant optional expedition approach scores.

diplomacy.name: Diplomacy
diplomacy.description: Negotiation, tact and persuasive delivery. Each rank adds 2 to optional social approach scores. Ordinary conversation choices always remain.

channeling.name: Channeling
channeling.description: Practised magical control. Each rank adds 2 to concentration routes. At combined Resolve + twice Channeling of 9, prepared field boosts gain one charge.

scholarship.name: Scholarship
scholarship.description: Each added rank gives +1 work contribution per assigned phase of shared research or living-index study. Does not accelerate personal learning, spell tests or rituals.

artifice.name: Artifice
artifice.description: Each added rank gives +1 work contribution when this person is the assigned artifact maker. Does not accelerate focus work, spell tests or ritual contributions.

fieldcraft.name: Fieldcraft
fieldcraft.description: Rank 1 reduces ordinary two-phase surveys to one phase (does not stack with lanterns or field notes) and opens careful channel work at Rainward. Rank 2 opens precise lens handling there without a lantern. No automatic extra rewards.

scoring.formula: attribute + 2 * skill rank + 2 for one capable present expedition helper
